preview.overview: The Revitalization Commission is scheduled to review its 2027 budget and consider two business improvement program applications. Residents can comment on these decisions or other matters.

items.why: The commission is being asked to approve its budget for the coming year.
The commission is being asked to consider and approve an improvement program application.

items.item: Empire Public House Improvement Program Application
items.why: The commission is being asked to consider and approve an improvement program application.
The commission will discuss development impact fees, which help fund public infrastructure.
Staff will provide updates and report on local business news.

preview.overview: The Cultural Advisory Board is scheduled to discuss the 2027 Louisville Arts Grants and receive updates on the World Music Series and Summer Concert Series. The board will also review roles and responsibilities for boards and commissions.

items.why: The board will discuss the upcoming arts grants program for 2027, which provides funding to local arts and cultural projects.
The board will receive an update on the World Music Series programming and initiatives.
The board will receive an update on the Summer Concert Series programming and initiatives.
The board will review and discuss the roles and responsibilities of local boards and commissions.
Staff will report on upcoming events including Transgender Day of Remembrance, Winter Fest, Motus Theater performance, and Home & Heart.

preview.overview: The Historical Museum Advisory Board is scheduled to review its work plan and receive updates on museum operations and foundation activities. Residents can comment on any items during the meeting.

items.why: The board will discuss and potentially act on the Historical Museum Advisory Board's work plan for upcoming initiatives.
The board will review and decide whether to approve gifts or donations to the museum.
The supervisor will provide an update on museum operations and activities.
The director will brief the board on cultural services activities and priorities.
The board will receive information about the museum foundation's status and activities.

preview.overview: The Sustainability Advisory Board will discuss and provide direction on a memo to City Council regarding a joint meeting. The board will also handle routine administrative items.

items.item: Discussion: LSAB memo to Council re: Joint Meeting
items.why: The board will discuss and provide direction on a memo to City Council concerning a joint meeting, though the specific purpose and content of the proposed joint meeting are not detailed in the agenda.

preview.overview: The Finance Committee is scheduled to review Louisville's 2027 budget priorities and utility rates, and discuss the committee's work plan for the coming year.

items.item: Revised 2027 utility rate presentation and discussion
items.why: The committee will review and discuss proposed changes to city utility rates for 2027.

items.item: Preliminary 2027 Finance Committee work plan discussion
items.why: The committee will discuss its planned priorities and activities for 2027.

items.item: Final citywide and Louisville Recreation Center budget amendment review
items.why: The committee will review final budget amendments for the city and recreation center.

items.item: Q3 revenue, sales and bag tax reports
items.why: The committee will receive reports on city revenue, sales tax, and bag tax collections for the third quarter.
